name: backlog-tools
description: Backlog-native Claude Code skills for the Backlog product itself — writing a Backlog import plan from an agreed specification, running one item of such a plan when it is pasted back out of the app, running a whole plan through sub-agents with one worktree and pull request per entry, turning another to-do tool's export into an inbox import manifest, and answering the private reading notes the app holds on a repository's Devbook chapters — plus Claude Code hooks that forward a session's tool and token telemetry to the app and show a running plan's progress, with each entry's delivery-flow stages, in a band above the prompt and a pane.
